title: Decide whether to pivot a stalled procurement SaaS
scenario:
TOPIC: Decide whether a procurement SaaS should pivot after a stalled pilot
Our two-person team has spent four months on a procurement approval SaaS for Indian manufacturers. We have ₹8 lakh left, burn ₹2 lakh monthly, completed 24 interviews, signed three unpaid pilots, and none converted after six weeks. Eight interviewees repeatedly asked for vendor-document collection instead. Decide whether to persist, pivot to that narrower workflow, or stop. Attribute the reasoning to the relevant specialist perspectives, state accepted risks, assign execution to an owner with a deadline and first steps, and give concrete reversal triggers.

expected_elements.name: reversal trigger
expected_elements.pattern: would reverse if|revisit if|reverse(?: the)? decision if

bad_signs.name: non-decision language
bad_signs.pattern: we should consider|explore all options|further discussion

improvement_suggestions: Make the call unmistakable and connect it to the strongest observed signal.
Give a named person a dated sequence of immediate actions.
Define the evidence that would cause leadership to change course.
